channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Residency: Schomburg Center Scholars-in-Residence 2027-28 (NYPL, Harlem; USD 35,000 long-term or USD 3,000 a month short-term; playwrights and creative writers eligible) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture, The New York Public Library
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: Long-term fellowship: USD 35,000 stipend. Short-term fellowship: USD 3,000 per month for one to three months. No application fee mentioned.

Residential fellowships for work on the history, politics, literature and culture of peoples of African descent that needs the Schomburg Center's collections.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: WHATIF: five-month digital art residency at NODE Studio NYC (USD 25,000 stipend) (closes 10 Dec)
item.description:
NODE Foundation
Deadline: 10 Dec 2026
Award: USD 5,000 monthly stipend for five months (USD 25,000 total; a collective shares one stipend), a dedicated workspace, technical support, and flights and lodging for a visit to the Palo Alto headquarters. Housing, relocation, local transport, living expenses, health insurance and visa sponsorship are not included. No application fee mentioned.

WHATIF is a five-month residency at NODE Studio NYC for people who want to pursue one burning question through digital art and technology. NODE Foundation runs a digital art space in Palo Alto and a studio in New York. WHO: anyone aged 18 or over.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: W. E. B. Du Bois Research Institute Fellows Program 2027-28 (Hutchins Center, Harvard; USD 70,000 to 75,000 for the academic year) (closes 14 Dec)
item.description:
W. E. B. Du Bois Research Institute, Hutchins Center for African and African American Research, Harvard University
Deadline: 14 Dec 2026
Award: Stipends of USD 70,000 to USD 75,000 for the ten-month academic year, adjusted for one-semester fellowships. Health insurance is not provided. No application fee.

The Fellows Program is the oldest activity of the W. E. B. Du Bois Research Institute, which has appointed fellows since 1975.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Sundance Episodic Lab 2027: Alfred P. Sloan Grant Track (science and technology series) (closes 3 Dec)
item.description:
Sundance Institute with the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
Deadline: 3 Dec 2026
Award: USD 17,000 grant plus creative support through the Episodic Lab. Submission fee waived with code EpSloanGrantX121426 on FilmFreeway.

An extended Sloan-only round of the Sundance Episodic Lab for original half-hour or one-hour series whose subject is science, technology or mathematics, or a scientist, engineer or mathematician. Open to a writer or a two-person writing team.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: GLEAM 2027: Request for Light-Based Artwork Proposals (Olbrich Botanical Gardens; honorariums USD 5,000 to 30,000) (closes 6 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Olbrich Botanical Gardens (City of Madison Parks Division and Olbrich Botanical Society)
Deadline: 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 CST
Award: All-inclusive honorarium of USD 5,000 to 30,000 per artwork, covering artist fee, materials, fabrication, travel, lodging, install and maintenance. Usually only one USD 30,000 project is selected; proposals under USD 25,000 get the most consideration. Free host lodging and loan projectors and speakers are available. No application fee stated.

GLEAM is an annual night-time light art exhibition across a 16-acre botanical garden and a 10,000 sq ft tropical conservatory.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: NYSCA/Wave Farm Media Arts Assistance Fund (MAAF) for Artists 2027 (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Wave Farm (NYSCA regrant)
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: Up to USD 7,500. No application fee.

A NYSCA regrant run by Wave Farm supporting New York State artists to complete or present new sound and moving-image works, including work with emergent technologies.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: WVU Libraries Artist in Residence 2027: Common Threads, Industry, Labor and Community (USD 1,000 honorarium) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
West Virginia University Libraries
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: USD 1,000 honorarium plus up to USD 1,000 materials and up to USD 3,000 travel and lodging. No application fee.

An archive-based residency in which the artist works with WVU Libraries' union records and oral histories on industry, labor and community. Digital media is eligible. ELIGIBILITY: US- and Canada-based artists aged 18 and over.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: University of Notre Dame: Love Ethic Social Innovator Fellowships 2028 (residency plus USD 15,000 and up to USD 50,000 project funding) (closes 11 Dec)
item.description:
University of Notre Dame, Institute for Ethics and the Common Good
Deadline: 11 Dec 2026
Award: Stipend for housing during the residency plus relocation support; USD 15,000 to the fellow's organisation to offset the four-week sabbatical; up to USD 50,000 in subgrant funding after the residency to pilot the proposed project; travel to all programme gatherings covered. No application fee.

Up to six short-term fellowships for practitioners outside academia (nonprofit leaders, community organisers, social workers, faith leaders, entrepreneurs, public-sector professionals) who want time and space to design a new initiative grounded in love-based ethics.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: Craigardan Trillium Fellowship 2027 (residency for artists, activists and scholars of color, USD 4,600 + USD 500 honorarium) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Craigardan
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: USD 4,600 fellowship toward a minimum two-week residency (covers the residency fee), plus a USD 500 honorarium. Travel, materials and personal expenses are not covered. USD 25 application fee (waivers available on request).

The Trillium Fellowship supports artists, activists and scholars of color working in any discipline who would benefit from the time and space to pursue their work or find creative retreat at Craigardan, a residency and farm in the Adirondacks.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: Kala Art Institute: Media Arts Fellowship 2027-28 (Berkeley; USD 3,000 stipend) (closes 1 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Kala Art Institute
Deadline: 1 Mar 2027
Award: USD 3,000 stipend plus facility access.

Kala's long-running Media Arts Fellowship supports four artists working in film and video, sound, animation, performance cinema and media installation. ELIGIBILITY: local, national and international artists not enrolled in a degree programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Postdoctoral Associates in AI in the Humanities and Social Sciences (Cornell University) 2027-2029 (closes 20 Nov)
item.description:
Cornell University, College of Arts and Sciences
Deadline: 20 Nov 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 70,000 per year plus full benefits and a USD 4,000 annual research account (further funds by application). No application fee.

A cohort of up to five two-year postdoctoral fellows working on AI from humanistic and social-science angles: social and cultural impacts of AI, computational methods, and the ethics, politics and history of AI.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Belfer Center Technology and Geopolitics Fellowship 2027-28 (Harvard Kennedy School) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs, Harvard Kennedy School
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026
Award: Stipend up to about USD 70,000 (predoctoral) or USD 80,000 (postdoctoral), plus small travel and research grants. No application fee.

Residential fellowships for doctoral candidates past general exams and PhDs (usually within five years) working on technology and geopolitics: AI, quantum, cyber, technology regulation, emerging technology and democracy, and US-China competition. Apply by 1 December 2026; letters due 15 December.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Princeton CITP Fellows Program 2027-28 (Postdoctoral Research Associate, Visiting Professional, Microsoft Visiting Professor) (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Princeton University, Center for Information Technology Policy (CITP)
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: Fully funded positions (salary not stated). No application fee.

CITP's fellows program brings researchers and practitioners to Princeton to work on technology policy, with three tracks: Postdoctoral Research Associate (recent or about-to-finish PhDs), Visiting Professional, and Microsoft Visiting Professor.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Embedded Ethics Postdoctoral Fellowship 2027-28 (Stanford McCoy Center and HAI) (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Stanford University, McCoy Family Center for Ethics in Society with the Institute for Human-Centered AI (HAI)
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 21:00 PST
Award: Expected salary USD 82,400. No application fee.

Postdoctoral fellows embed ethics into Stanford computer science courses, developing and teaching modules on the ethics of AI and computing while pursuing their own research, hosted by the McCoy Center with HAI.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Florence Levy Kay Postdoctoral Fellowship in Computer Music and Engineering (Brandeis University) 2027-2029 (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Brandeis University (Department of Music and Engineering)
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 64,000 for the nine-month year (lecturer rank), plus USD 4,000 a year for research and travel and negotiable first-year relocation. No application fee.

A two-year postdoctoral fellowship in computer music and engineering: human/machine music-making, signal processing, and instrument and interface design, hosted by Brandeis Music and Engineering.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Yale Law School Information Society Project: Resident Fellowship 2027-2028 (closes 10 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Yale Law School, Information Society Project (ISP)
Deadline: 10 Jan 2027
Award: USD 70,000 per year plus Yale benefits and a travel stipend. No application fee.

Postdoctoral resident fellowships at Yale ISP for scholars of law and technology, with AI as a stated priority alongside the digital public sphere, content moderation, privacy, antitrust and algorithmic governance.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Folger Institute Artistic Research Fellowships 2027-28 (USD 4,000 to 5,000 per month) (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Folger Shakespeare Library (Folger Institute)
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 4,000 per virtual month or USD 5,000 per onsite month.

Artistic research fellowships for artists whose work needs primary research on the early modern world (about 1400 to 1800) and its legacies, using the Folger's collections. ELIGIBILITY: any artist; no degree required and no citizenship rule stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Florence Levy Kay Postdoctoral Fellowship in Generative AI and Political Science (Brandeis University) 2027-2029 (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Brandeis University (Department of Politics and Department of Computer Science)
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 64,000 per year plus benefits (pending budget approval). No application fee.

A two-year postdoctoral fellowship applying generative AI, NLP and machine-learning tools to questions in political science, hosted jointly by Brandeis Politics and Computer Science. The fellow pursues their own research and teaches two courses a year.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fellowship: Spencer Education Journalism Fellowship 2027-28 (Columbia Journalism School) (closes 4 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Spencer Fellowship at Columbia Journalism School
Deadline: 4 Feb 2027
Award: Residential stipend USD 85,000 or non-residential stipend USD 43,000, plus a USD 7,500 travel and research budget. Non-residential fellows also get airfare and hotel for required NYC trips. No application fee.

The Spencer Education Journalism Fellowship, based at Columbia Journalism School, supports ambitious, research-savvy storytellers producing books, magazine features, documentaries and podcasts that deepen public understanding of critical issues in education.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Postdoctoral Associate in Mathematical Foundations of Generative AI (University of Minnesota) 2027 (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
University of Minnesota Twin Cities, School of Mathematics (group of Yulong Lu)
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 69,000 per year plus benefits. No application fee.

An NSF-funded postdoc on the mathematical theory of generative AI, especially diffusion and flow models, in Yulong Lu's group with collaborators at Duke and Yale. Includes teaching two courses a year.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Open call: Tribeca Festival 2027: Tribeca Games Submissions (including VR and AR) (closes 4 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Tribeca Festival
Deadline: 4 Mar 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Fees USD 60 (official deadline 2 December 2026) or USD 80 (extended deadline 4 March 2027). Official selections can enter the D.I.C.E. Awards with the fee waived.

Tribeca Games takes unreleased web, console, VR, AR and mobile games (no tabletop) for the 2027 festival. Official deadline 2 December 2026, extended deadline 4 March 2027, both 11:59 pm ET.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Atlanta Interdisciplinary AI Network (AIAI): Seed Grants 2026 for humanities-forward AI research in Atlanta (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Atlanta Interdisciplinary AI Network (AIAI), Mellon Foundation funded
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: Up to USD 5,000 per project. In line with Mellon policy, no institutional overhead may be charged. Individuals taking the award outside an institution or employer pay income tax on it. No application fee.

AIAI funds humanities-forward AI research and community building that takes place in, or is focused on, the city of Atlanta. 2026 RESEARCH AREAS: Data Centers; AI Civics; AI Literacies; AI and Archives; Small Language Models; Capitalism, Anticapitalism, and Critique.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: GovAI Summer Fellowship 2027 (AI governance, London or Washington DC, GBP 14,000 for 3 months) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026, 23:59 GMT
Award: GBP 14,000 for 3 months plus travel support (UK Research and Applied Tracks, London); USD 24,500 plus travel support for the Washington DC track. No application fee.

GovAI's Summer Fellowship brings early-career researchers and practitioners into AI governance for three months of full-time work on a research or applied project under the mentorship of a GovAI researcher.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Van Alen Institute: Re:Paris Prize, USD 35,000 travel research fellowship on design in Africa and its diaspora (US-based applicants) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Van Alen Institute
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026
Award: USD 35,000 travel fellowship; one US-based winner selected through this open call (two Africa-based winners were selected via the 2026 Pan-African Biennale).

The Re:Paris Prize, run by Van Alen Institute, funds research into how design plays a transformative role in Africa and its diaspora. Each winner receives a USD 35,000 travel fellowship for field research that requires international travel to connect with experts and opportunities.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Knight-Wallace Journalism Fellowships 2027-28 (University of Michigan) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Wallace House Center for Journalists, University of Michigan
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 85,000 stipend plus USD 5,000 relocation (figures from secondary listings; confirm on the official site).

An academic-year fellowship for mid-career journalists to pursue a study project at the University of Michigan, with seminars and programming at Wallace House. DEADLINES: international applicants 1 December 2026, 11:59 pm ET; US applicants 1 February 2027. No application fee stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IHS AI and the Workforce Research Grants (up to USD 20,000) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Institute for Humane Studies (IHS)
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: Up to USD 20,000 per award; larger awards possible for exceptional projects. Covers research costs (research assistants, datasets, LLM subscriptions, travel to present), not salary or overhead.

Research grants for academic scholars studying how AI is changing jobs, productivity and economic opportunity. Economics-leaning; IHS is a libertarian-leaning institute. Funds direct research costs only. No country restriction stated. Deadline 15 December 2026 (no time zone given).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Knight Science Journalism Academic-Year Fellowship 2027-28 (MIT) (closes 9 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Knight Science Journalism Program at MIT
Deadline: 9 Jan 2027
Award: USD 87,500 stipend over 9.5 months, plus USD 5,000 for travel and housing, health insurance and a childcare subsidy. No application fee.

An academic-year fellowship at MIT for journalists covering science, health, technology or the environment, with seminars, MIT and Harvard courses and a self-directed study project.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Generator Residency (Kairos x Constellation, Winter 2027)
item.description: Kairos and Constellation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 8,500 per month stipend (some Embedded track residents employed at a roughly equivalent salary), plus travel to and from Berkeley. No application fee.

item.title: NBER i3: Open Data Fellows Program 2027
item.description: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Innovation Information Initiative (i3) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 1,500 per fellow, at least five fellowships, plus travel reimbursement to present at the i3 Technical Working Group meeting in December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Interactive Media Installations (up to USD 9,000 each)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 9,000 per installation, for up to five installations. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Lytton Plaza Installation Commission (USD 20,000)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · USD 20,000 commission budget. No application fee.

item.title: Postdoctoral Fellow 2027, Crockett Lab (Princeton Psychology and University Center for Human Values)
item.description: Princeton University, Crockett Lab (Department of Psychology and University Center for Human Values) · deadline 20 Nov 2026 · USD 80,000 annual salary from a stable institutional funding source (not a cancellable grant).
